title: Commercial Sales Executive - Insurance
description:
Commercial Sales Executive - Insurance

30,000 - 40,000 Basic + Bonus Northampton Hybrid Working

Do you enjoy winning new business, building relationships and creating opportunities rather than simply managing an existing portfolio?

We're recruiting for an ambitious, commercially minded Sales Executive to join an established and highly respected insurance agency in Pitsford.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys the thrill of bringing new clients on board, developing their own portfolio and building long-term commercial relationships.

You'll have the freedom to get out into the local business community, meet decision-makers, understand their challenges and identify opportunities to provide the right solutions.

This isn't an account management role where you're simply looking after an existing book. You'll play an active role in growing the business, winning new customers and developing a portfolio of your own.

What will you be doing?
- Proactively identifying and winning new commercial clients across the SME market.
- Building your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, referrals and business development.
- Arranging and attending face-to-face meetings and site visits with local businesses.
- Building relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers.
- Understanding customer requirements and providing tailored, consultative solutions.
- Identifying opportunities to grow existing relationships through additional products and services.
- Developing and retaining the clients you bring into the business, building a valuable long-term portfolio.
- Working towards sales and growth targets, with the opportunity to directly influence your own success.

Who would suit this opportunity?

We're interested in people who genuinely enjoy business development and have the drive to go out and win new business.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience in B2 B sales, business development or consultative solution selling.
- A proven ability to identify opportunities, generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Confidence speaking with business owners, directors and senior decision-makers.
- A relationship-led approach, with the commercial drive to turn conversations into new business.
- Enjoyment of face-to-face meetings, networking and getting out to visit customers.
- A self-motivated, target-driven approach and the ambition to grow your own portfolio.

Insurance experience isn't essential. We're open to individuals from other B2 B sales backgrounds who can demonstrate strong commercial sales ability, a consultative approach and a genuine appetite for winning new business.

What's on offer?
- 30,000 - 40,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- Bonus scheme offering additional earning potential.
- 35-hour working week, Monday to Friday.
- Hybrid working available following initial training and probation.
- Full industry training and support towards a funded CII qualification.
- The opportunity to develop and grow your own commercial client portfolio.
- Clear opportunities to progress into more senior positions as the business grows.
- A stable, established business with a strong reputation and long-term career prospects.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- Life assurance, income protection and contributory pension.
- Free onsite parking.

The opportunity

This is a chance to build something of your own within an established business.

You'll have the backing, training and support of an experienced team, while having the opportunity to make your mark through the relationships you develop and the business you bring in.

If you're commercially driven, enjoy meeting people and want a role where business development is genuinely at the heart of what you do, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Entry Level Sales Consultant - Insurance
description:
Sales Consultant - Insurance

Northampton 25,000 basic + Uncapped Monthly Bonus Full-Time, Permanent

Got a natural way with people? Enjoy sales and want a career where you can genuinely progress?

We're looking for confident, friendly and motivated individuals to join an established and award-winning business in Northampton.

You don't need insurance experience. What we're really interested in is people who have some experience in sales, whether that's working in retail, a call centre, hospitality or another customer-facing environment.

If you enjoy talking to people, building rapport and turning a conversation into a sale, this could be a great opportunity to develop your career.

What's the role?

You'll be joining a friendly sales team, speaking with customers interested in specialist insurance products covering caravans, park homes, boats, holiday homes and lodges.

It's a mixture of inbound and outbound telephone sales, with approximately 60% inbound calls and 40% outbound.

Importantly, this isn't about picking up the phone and cold calling random people. You'll be speaking with customers who have made enquiries, responded to marketing campaigns or are approaching their insurance renewal.

Your job is to understand what they're looking for, have a genuine conversation and help them find the right product.

Day-to-day responsibilities:
- Handle inbound enquiries and make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers.
- Build rapport and understand customers' needs through natural conversations.
- Provide quotations and explain suitable insurance products.
- Convert enquiries into sales and work towards achievable monthly targets.
- Deliver a positive customer experience from the initial conversation through to completion.
- Keep customer information accurate and up to date.
- Work alongside a supportive team to achieve individual and team targets.

What we're looking for

We're much more interested in your attitude, personality and sales ability than whether you've worked in insurance before.

You could currently be working in:
- Retail sales, where you're used to approaching customers and recommending products.
- A call centre or telephone-based sales environment.
- Hospitality or customer service, where building rapport comes naturally.
- A sales assistant or customer-facing role where you've worked towards targets.

Ideally, you'll have around a year's experience in a sales or customer-facing environment, but we're open to hearing from people with the right attitude and potential.

We're looking for someone who:
- Is naturally friendly, approachable and confident speaking with people.
- Enjoys having conversations and getting to know customers.
- Has a genuine interest in sales and achieving targets.
- Can recommend products without coming across as overly pushy.
- Is motivated to learn, develop and build a long-term career.
- Is reliable, positive and enjoys being part of a team.

You don't need to be a polished salesperson. Being down to earth, personable and comfortable talking to everyday customers is far more important.

What's in it for you?

This is more than just another sales job. The business is keen to develop people and give them the opportunity to grow their earnings and responsibilities as they progress.
- 24,785 starting basic salary, dependent on experience.
- Uncapped monthly bonus, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings.
- Salary increases as you develop: As you learn and take on additional insurance products, your salary increases too.
- Full training from day one, with no previous insurance experience required.
- Genuine opportunities for career progression.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days with service.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- A friendly, supportive working environment.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9am-5.30pm, with one Saturday in every four weeks, 9am-1pm.

37.5 hours per week.

Interested?

If you've got some sales or customer-facing experience, enjoy speaking with people and want an opportunity to build a career with a company that will invest in your development, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Head of Telesales
description:

Location: Northampton

Hours: Full-time, permanent

Salary: £50,000 £60,000 basic, + Commission

Duties of a Head of Telesales:
- Lead, manage and develop a high-performing outbound telesales and lead generation team.
- Recruit, train and motivate Sales Development Representatives.

- Drive new business opportunities through proactive B2 B outbound calling.

What we would like from you:
- Proven experience in a senior B2 B telesales or outbound sales leadership position.

- Excellent coaching, leadership and motivational skills.
- Confident communication and relationship-building abilities.
- Experience developing outbound sales campaigns and lead generation strategies.
- Strong understanding of KPIs, conversion rates and sales performance management.
- A proactive, commercially driven approach with the ability to lead from the front.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive
Northampton
Full-time, permanent
30,000 basic + uncapped commission + company bonus
If you enjoy building relationships, spotting opportunities and turning conversations into results, this could be the role for you.
We're working with an established, award-winning business that supplies a range of technical products to organisations across the UK. With ambitious growth plans and a strong focus on customer service, they're looking for motivated salespeople who want to develop their skills, earn great money and be part of a team that genuinely supports one another.
This isn't a hard-sell, high-pressure environment. It's about understanding customers, finding the right solutions and building relationships that lead to long-term business.
You'll be joining a business where ambition and teamwork go hand in hand. Success is celebrated, ideas are encouraged and people are given the opportunity to grow. From team awards and regular learning sessions to social events and shared successes, there's plenty going on beyond the day-to-day sales targets.
The culture is built around accountability, honesty, high standards and continuous improvement. You'll be encouraged to bring your own personality, contribute ideas and make a real impact.
Key Duties:
- Managing incoming enquiries, warm leads and relationships with existing customers to identify sales opportunities.
- Speaking with businesses to understand their requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions.
- Preparing quotations, negotiating where appropriate and converting opportunities into sales.
- Building lasting customer relationships through helpful, professional and consistent communication.
- Keeping track of opportunities, customer interactions and sales activity using the company's CRM system.
- Working closely with colleagues and suppliers to deliver the best possible solutions.
- Developing your product knowledge and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.
- Taking ownership of your targets while contributing to the wider team's success.
- Most of your work will be handled over the phone, email and Microsoft Teams, with occasional visits to key customers.

The Ideal Candidate:
We're interested in people who have the drive to succeed and the attitude to do it the right way.
- Have experience in B2 B sales, account management or another customer-facing commercial role.
- Enjoy working towards targets and are motivated by the opportunity to earn uncapped commission.
- Are confident communicating with different people and building rapport.
- Can identify customer needs, ask the right questions and recommend suitable solutions.
- Stay positive when things don't go to plan and are willing to learn from setbacks.
- Take responsibility for your work, welcome feedback and look for ways to improve.
- Enjoy being part of a team where people support each other and celebrate shared success.
- A strong work ethic, commercial awareness and a genuine commitment to customers are what matter most.
- Experience selling technical products would be useful, but it's not essential. Full product knowledge can be developed on the job.

What's in it for you?
- 30,000 basic salary plus uncapped commission and a company bonus.
- 31 days' annual leave, including bank holidays, plus your birthday off.
- Health cash plan, 24/7 employee assistance programme and shopping discounts.
- Dedicated training budget, ongoing coaching and clear opportunities for career progression.
- Regular development discussions to help you build your skills and progress.
- A supportive team environment with company events, socials and recognition for great work.
- Free on-site EV charging.

Some benefits, including flexible working and health and wellbeing benefits, are available after successful completion of probation.

title: Internal Account Manager
company: M TWO Search Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
About you

You're someone who enjoys building relationships with customers, knows how to spot an opportunity and isn't afraid to pick up the phone.

You'll already have experience within print, signage, large-format graphics or exhibition displays, so you'll understand the products, the customers and how the industry works.

We're looking for someone who's commercially minded, organised and comfortable managing multiple accounts without letting things slip through the cracks.

Your experience

You'll have worked in internal sales, account management or a similar customer-facing role within the industry.

You'll be comfortable putting together quotations, following up on enquiries, developing existing relationships and finding ways to generate more business.

You don't need to be a hard-nosed salesperson, but you do need to enjoy the commercial side of account management and be confident having conversations with customers.

What you'll be doing

You'll be looking after a portfolio of up to 150 trade customers, becoming their main point of contact and helping grow the business they place.

A big part of the role will involve keeping in touch with existing customers, bringing lapsed accounts back on board and spotting opportunities to introduce additional products.

You'll also work closely with the wider sales and customer service teams, supporting regional sales targets, managing quotations and making sure customers are looked after properly.

It's a proactive role, so there'll be plenty of time spent on the phone rather than simply waiting for enquiries to come in.

About the business

You'll be joining an established business supplying display and exhibition solutions to trade customers across the industry.

They're continuing to grow, and this is an additional position within their sales operation to help develop customer relationships and increase revenue.

There's an established customer base to work with, a broad product offering and support from the wider team.

Next steps

If you've got experience within print, signage or displays and enjoy the relationship-building side of sales, we'd be keen to have a chat.

Drop us a message and we'll talk you through the opportunity.
